description: Recto (secondary use): Accounts in Arabic. Mentions al-Yahūdī Ibn al-Raʾīs al-Shaykh Bū l-Faraj (this is probably Eliyyahu b. Zekharya); al-Naṣrānī; Ṭāhir al-Simsār (who has or owes a nice qumqum); al-Yahūdī; Mūsā; al-Faqīh Manṣūr; Bū Naṣr(?) al-Naṣrānī; and Ibn al-Baghdādī.
description_he: ערבית: רשימת שמות (רקטו); עברית: פתיחת מכתב (ורסו)
